title: Data Ethics in Small Datasets
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting data ethics in small datasets to Excel pivot-table finding with unit labels, source note, and claim-first chart title, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Identify when a small dataset is re-identifiable through a combination of quasi-identifiers even after direct identifiers are removed
Apply a three-point ethics screen (re-identification, group-of-one, honest magnitude) to decide how to report a small-n finding
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
